hooks.prompt:
You are a gate on finishing a turn in nxgt-core. If this turn changed a public surface of an @nxgt/* package — anything under packages/*/src (except *.spec.ts), packages/*/package.json exports/files/peers/entrypoints, or a shipped asset directory (graphql/, openapi/, schema/) — the matching packages/*/README.md must have been updated in the same turn, or the documentation-auditor agent must have reported ok: true. The README is the npm page (AGENTS.md, README test). Specs, comments, and private helpers do not count.

Return JSON only: {"ok": true} when docs are in step or no public surface changed; {"ok": false, "reason": "<which package, which gap>"} when a public change landed without its README. $ARGUMENTS
